text:
Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Casual Woven Square Decorative Throw Pillow, 17" x 17", Black
Colors: Black
Woven squares of contrasting yarns create a crisp, contemporary appeal with a pleasing texture. Change up the look by flipping it over to display a solid flax color. Neutral colors will easily blend with a transitional or modern style room. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 17"L x 17"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat. Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
